name: Plenoptic Sampling Guided 3DGS Construction
definition: A white-box 3DGS construction strategy that theoretically derives the minimum sampling rate of sampled views and the distribution of 3D Gaussians based on mesh geometry, enabling Nyquist-level global-illumination caching.
summary: Plenoptic Sampling Guided 3DGS Construction initializes 3D Gaussian Splatting from mesh geometry using signal processing principles to minimize sampling while ensuring high-fidelity rendering.
